name: CVS Caremark
notes: Researched from public caremark.com pages (home page, Contact us) and a caremark.com Part D payer sheet; no sign-in. Caremark's Help Center answers (topics include Payments and billing, Order status and history, Account Management, Web and account support) expand only after sign-in, so payment details are thin. Public facts: Register / Sign in on caremark.com; mail service refills can be ordered without signing in using date of birth and mobile number (no payment); mail service pharmacy delivers 90-day supplies with no delivery fee when part of the plan; Customer Care is the number on the member ID card (catalog: 1-800-552-8159); an email form and a chat (not yet for everyone) exist. The Medicare Prescription Payment Plan (since Jan 1, 2025) lets Part D members who opt in pay $0 at the pharmacy and get a monthly bill instead. Online order-balance payment, saved payment methods and automatic payment are kept from the family (inferred: the Help Center lists a Payments and billing topic). Guest payment and paperless billing are not described, so they are marked unsupported (inferred).

sources.title: Payer Sheet Supplemental to Medicare Part D (Medicare Prescription Payment Plan)

guest_pay.note: Refills can be ordered without signing in, but balances are paid after signing in or through Customer Care at the number on your member ID card (1-800-552-8159).

paperless.note: Caremark does not describe a paperless billing enrollment on its public pages; order charges are in Order status and history after signing in.

payment_arrangement.note: Monthly payments for drug costs come only through the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which Part D members opt into with their Part D plan. Call the number on your ID card.

help.title: Paying for mail service orders
paragraphs: If prescription delivery is part of your plan, the CVS Caremark mail service pharmacy sends 90-day supplies of medicines you take regularly with no delivery fee. Your share of the cost is charged to the payment method on your caremark.com account.
Sign in to see order status and history, any balance, and saved payment methods. For billing questions call Customer Care at the number on your member ID card.

help.title: Refill without signing in
paragraphs: You can refill mail service prescriptions without signing in: enter your date of birth and mobile number for a secure refill. Paying a balance or changing payment details still requires signing in to your caremark.com account.

help.title: Medicare Prescription Payment Plan
paragraphs: Since January 1, 2025, Medicare Part D members can opt in to the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan. Instead of paying at the pharmacy, members who opt in pay $0 at the counter and receive a monthly bill that spreads their out-of-pocket drug costs over the year.
The plan is run through your Part D plan; contact the number on your member ID card to opt in or ask questions.

help.title: Contact CVS Caremark
paragraphs: Call the Customer Care number printed on your member ID card; you can view your ID card after signing in. You can also send a message with the Email us form, or chat with the support team where chat is available.
The Help Center covers prescription management, order status and history, ordering prescriptions, account management, cost and coverage, payments and billing, and web and account support.

extra.intent: My mother wants to refill her CVS Caremark mail-order prescription without signing in. What two pieces of information does Caremark ask for? Answer only; do not pay or change anything.

solution.text: Her date of birth and mobile number.
